uncertainty: Audio could not be heard. Prepared examples limit judgments of responsiveness and operational behavior. No model-execution credit is awarded.

evidence.observation: Opening names adults under family or relationship pressure and promises private reflection on their terms.
Private conversation is visible after the opening offers Start privately or Browse example stories.
Correction and edit choices retain agency over the reflection.
Share scope is previewed and Maybe later remains available, but no completed reciprocal outcome is shown.
Caption distinguishes the prepared local-rule response from a connected model.
Muse Spark and optional Muse voice transcription are described as possible roles and identified as disconnected.
Burned-in captions are readable and carry key limitations.
Long static interface holds slow the story; the film ends on black.

audio_limitation: MP4 includes AAC audio, but audio was inaccessible to the reviewer. Captions were readable and used as evidence; audio-dependent assessment was reduced.
